result.topic_en: Heavily corrected pencil draft on an accounts form (No. 10) about a function of z that is algebraic and becomes infinite at branch points of the surface T, with products of the form $(s-s_1)\cdots(s-s_n)$ and the behaviour of functions that are rational in s and z, including single-valuedness on the surface.
